a.lede: Movie studios are turning to the horror fiction site SCP Foundation and showing how dealing with that community can go right, and wrong.
a.title: Neon will make a truly open-source SCP movie after A24 controversy

b.lede: A24 pissed off one of the internet's largest horror communities when it announced it was working on an SCP Foundation film, but apparently hadn't bothered to contact the SCP Wiki team, nor did it commit to releasing it under a Creative Commons license as required.
